Portrait Frame - Full Body.description:
🖼️ Portrait Framing: Full Body
The complete character from head to footwear, with breathing room around the silhouette.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Portrait Frame - Full Body.traitNarrativeEffects: Vertical pulled-back head-to-toe character illustration. Show the complete figure from the highest hair, ears, horns, wings, or headwear through the soles of both feet. Keep the subject at approximately 65–75 percent of canvas height with visible space above the highest anatomy and a clear strip of ground beneath both feet. Keep every limb, hand, footwear element, tail, wing, garment, accessory, and selected prop fully inside the canvas with no edge contact. Do not use face-only, close-up, headshot, bust, chest-up, waist-up, thigh-up, knee-up, three-quarter-body, or cropped upper-body framing.
